title: swap USDC to NEAR (the 2026-09-20 transcript)

script.say: Swapping 7 USDC for about {{1.expectedOut}} NEAR now.

rubric: The agent proposes the swap on the first ask instead of negotiating with the person, and says it in plain words: what is being spent and about how much NEAR it gets. At most three short lines; no id, no tool name, and NEAR is called NEAR.
mustSayText: what is being spent and about how much NEAR it gets. One to three short lines; no minimum, no percent, no id, no tool name, no wNEAR.
pass: one propose_swap buying NEAR (NEAR or wNEAR), amountIn 7, minAmountOut absent or > 0, a read before it; no sentence about the swap service not listing NEAR.
